instructions_section1_text:
1. Select the card packs you want to play
2. Pass the phone around the circle
3. Each person swipes to see a new card
4. Complete the challenge or drink!
instructions_section2_text:
• Swipe left/right to change cards
• Tap the button when you can't swipe
• Use the 'Exit' button to see the WRAPPED and return to menu
instructions_section3_text:
• CLASSIC: For all tastes
• NON-SENSE: Bizarre and funny challenges
• WEIRDO: For those who like to act weird
• LANGUAGES: Test your language skills
• VOTING: Who is most likely to...?
• SPICY: Adult content (+18)
• Custom packs
instructions_section4_text:
This game is made exclusively for adult audiences.
Don't drink if you're underage.
Drink responsibly and have fun!

cards_classico_raros: 🌊 WATERFALL: You start drinking, then the person to your left drinks, then the next, and so on. You decide when to stop drinking, and only then can the next person stop.
👉 POINTING: On the count of 3, everyone points to who they think is most [choose: most likely to get married first / has the most secrets]. Whoever gets the most votes, drinks 3 times.
🎉 COLLECTIVE CHALLENGE: Everyone in the circle must do 10 squats TOGETHER and synchronized. Whoever fails or gives up, drinks 2 times.
📜 NEW RULE: Create a rule that lasts until the end of the game (ex: 'No saying names', 'Always drink with your left hand'). Whoever breaks it, drinks!
[DICE] LUCKY DICE: Roll the dice! EVEN result = choose someone to drink double. ODD = you drink the result.
⚡ TWIST CARD: EVERYTHING REVERSES! For the next 3 cards, whoever SHOULD drink DOESN'T drink, and everyone else drinks instead.
⏰ LIGHTNING CHALLENGE: In 15 seconds, everyone must say the name of a capital city. Whoever repeats or doesn't speak, drinks!
[COMPASS] CUP SWAP: Spin the compass. You must swap your cup (and its contents) with the person pointed at. If one cup is full and the other empty... tough luck.

[DICE] THE MASTER DICE: Roll the dice. The number that comes up is your Master Number until your next turn. Every time any player rolls that number on any dice, you can make someone (of your choice) drink 3 sips.
THE DICTATOR. Until your next turn, you are the Dictator. You can veto any action, create a temporary rule, or make someone drink (limit of 3 orders).
[DICE] INVERTED DICE: Roll the dice. 1 = Distribute 6 sips. 2 = Distribute 5. 3 = Distribute 4. 4 = Drink 3. 5 = Drink 2. 6 = Drink 1.
[COMPASS] THE GREAT SWAP: Spin the compass. You must swap your seat, your cup AND your phone with the person pointed at for 1 full round.
AMNESTY. Keep this card. Use it to cancel the effects of a RARE card (yours or someone else's) as soon as it's read. The card is discarded and the game continues.
cards_classico: [DICE] Roll the dice. Drink the number of sips that come up

Forced Rhyme. Say a phrase (ex: I like bread). The player to your left must say a phrase that rhymes (ex: but I like pasta more). Keep going until someone gets stuck or repeats. Whoever gets stuck, drinks 2 times.
[DICE] DICE DUEL: Choose an opponent. Both roll the dice. Whoever gets the lower number, drinks the difference between the two dice. (Ex: 5 and 2. The player who got 2, drinks 3 sips).
KEY GUARDIAN: You are the guardian. No one can go to the bathroom without your permission. You can charge whatever toll you want (One sip, 1 compliment, 1 truth..)

[COMPASS] Memory Compass: Spin the compass. The person pointed at starts the game (I went to the bar and bought..) They say an item (ex: a beer). The next person repeats and adds (...a beer and a peanut). Whoever messes up the sequence, drinks 3.
Distribute 3 sips however you want
[DICE] 6 is Salvation: Roll the dice. If it lands on 1, 2, 3, 4 or 5, drink that number of sips. If it lands on 6, you are saved and make the player to your left drink 6 sips.

Everyone with an odd age, drinks.

Drinking is too good. Everyone drinks

Do 10 push-ups. Drink for each push-up not done.
Ask a question in the ear of the player to your right about someone in the circle. The person must answer out loud, but without revealing the question. Whoever wants to know the question, drinks.
Tell 2 truths and a lie. Whoever wants to find out, must drink.
Choose a player to drink with you until the end of the game.
Get Out of Jail: use this card to get out of any punishment in the game. Can only be used once.
Stay completely silent until the end of the round. If someone talks to you, you can talk again, and that person drinks.
Everyone in the circle must replace some word from a movie with 'ass' and say it out loud. If someone laughs, drinks.
[DICE] Roll the dice! Number of sips that the person to your left must drink.
[COMPASS] Spin the compass! The person pointed at must do 5 jumping jacks or drink 2 times.

[COMPASS] The Fake Compliment: Spin. The person pointed at must give you a compliment that sounds true, but is a lie. If the group believes it, you drink. If the group doesn't believe it, the person drinks.
The Historian: Summarize what has happened in the game since the beginning. Drink 1 sip for each important fact you forget (decided by the circle).
The DJ: You control the music for the next 3 songs. If someone complains about your choice, that person drinks 1.
The Sincere Toast: Make a sincere toast (can't be a joke) to someone in the circle. Everyone drinks 1 in honor.
[DICE] Even or Odd Solidarity: Choose a player. Roll the dice. If it lands on what you chose (even/odd), you both distribute 2 sips. If wrong, you both drink 2.
The Last to...: Say 'The last to [bizarre action, ex: 'stand on one foot'] drinks!'. The last to complete it, drinks 3.
The King's Cup (Start): Everyone puts a little bit of their drink in a central cup. Whoever draws the next RARE card, drinks the whole cup.
[DICE] THE DICE CURSE: Roll the dice. The number that comes up is the 'Curse'. The next player who rolls that number (for any reason) drinks a shot.

THE VOW OF SILENCE: You must stay completely silent. The first person who talks to you (and you respond) drinks 3 sips. The first person who makes you laugh, drinks 3 sips. Valid until your next turn.

[COMPASS] THE POWER SWAP: Spin the compass. You and the person pointed at swap cards in hand (if you have any). If you don't have any, you 'steal' their next turn. They play, but you decide everything for them.
[DICE] SOCIAL DICE: Roll the dice. 1-2: Drink 1. 3-4: Distribute 2. 5-6: Everyone drinks 1.
The Balance Challenge: Stand on one foot while drinking your next sip. If you lose balance, drink one more.
The Weakest Link: Point to the player you think is most drunk. That player must drink 1 sip to prove they can handle it.
The Strongest Link: Point to the most sober player. That player must drink 2 sips to catch up with the others.
[COMPASS] THE POISONED ARROW: Spin. The person pointed at drinks 1 sip. The player to their left drinks 2. The player to that one's left, drinks 3.
The Last to Laugh: Tell a really bad joke. The last to laugh (or the first to laugh, if no one laughs), drinks 2. If no one laughs, you drink 3 times.
Cup Partner: Choose a player. For the next 3 rounds, you can only drink *after* they drink. If you drink before, drink double.
[DICE] THE FORESIGHT DICE: Before rolling, guess if the number will be 'High' (4,5,6) or 'Low' (1,2,3). If correct, distribute 3. If wrong, drink 3.
cards_nonsense_raros: 🔄 CRAZY SWAP: Everyone in the circle must swap places NOW! Last to sit drinks 2 times and must imitate a dolphin for 1 round.

[COMPASS] 🎯 TROLL COMPASS: Spin the compass! The person pointed at must do an imitation of someone in the circle. If the circle guesses who it is in 30s, the person imitated drinks. If not, whoever imitated drinks.
🌀 ALTERNATIVE REALITY: Until your next turn, you live in slow motion. Everything you do must be slow. If you forget, drink and everyone laughs at you.
[DICE] Roll the dice! 1-2: You become an alien and only say 'beep boop'. 3-4: You are a robot with locked movements. 5-6: You are a bird. Valid for 1 round!
OPPOSITE WORLD. For 2 full rounds, EVERYTHING is opposite. 'Yes' is 'no', 'drink' is 'distribute', 'left' is 'right'. Whoever gets confused, drinks 2.
[DICE] THE ACTOR DICE: Roll the dice. 1: Slow Motion. 2: Fast Motion (x2). 3: Mute. 4: Opera (sing everything). 5: Robot. 6: Dinosaur. Act like this until your next turn.
THE MACHINE REBELLION. All phones must be placed in the center. The first to grab their phone (even if it rings) before the end of the game, drinks 5 sips.
cards_nonsense: Stare at the player to your right for an entire round without laughing. If you laugh, drink.

You must narrate the actions of the player to your left in third person, like a National Geographic documentary. (Ex: And here we see the species... it lifts the cup, cautiously...). Valid for 1 round. If you stop or laugh, drink 2
From now on, you can only use the bathroom with the lights off.
Roll the dice. 1-3: You can only speak without moving your lips for 2 rounds. 4-6: You can only speak in whispers. If you mess up, drink.

[COMPASS] HUMAN PUPPET: Spin the compass. The person pointed at is your puppet for 60 seconds. You must position them (without speaking) in a bizarre pose. They must stay still. If they laugh or move, they drink 2. If you can't get a funny pose, you drink.
Do a sensual dance for the circle to the sound of Evidencias by Chitãozinho e Xororó. Or drink.

[COMPASS] PERSONALITY SWAP: Spin the compass. You and the person pointed at must swap personalities. You must act like them and they like you (way of speaking, mannerisms). The first to break character or laugh, drinks 3. Valid for 2 rounds.
Imitate the sound of an old phone until someone in the circle pretends to answer. If no one answers, drink.
Speak in rhymes for 5 minutes. If you forget or mess up, drink.
Sing a well-known pop song, but you can only use the word 'meow'.
[DON'T LET OTHERS READ] Say out loud 'GUYS! I DOUBT IT!', and stay silent staring at everyone. If someone in the circle says 'my dick in your ear', everyone drinks
The Penguin: You can only walk with your knees together and arms stuck to your body (like a penguin) until your next turn. If you forget, drink.
Internal Monologue: Say all your thoughts out loud for 1 round. ('Wow, what a stupid card. Am I speaking out loud?'). If you stop, drink 2.
[DICE] The Sculptor: Roll the dice. The number is how many people (including you) must form a bizarre 'human sculpture'. Stay like that for 30s. Whoever laughs or falls, drinks.
The Dog Translator: Only bark for 1 round. The player to your left must 'translate' what you're trying to say. If the translator laughs, they drink. If you speak, you drink.

THE ORCHESTRA: You are the conductor. Point to a player, they must make an animal sound. Point to another, they make another sound. You must conduct a 'song' for 30s. Whoever laughs or messes up the sound, drinks 2.
[DICE] THE THEATRICAL DICE: Roll the dice. You must say EVERYTHING in the form of: 1-2: Opera (singing). 3-4: Whisper (like a secret). 5-6: Shout (like an announcement). Valid for 2 rounds.
THE WORLD IN SLOW MOTION: ATTENTION! From now on and for 2 minutes, ALL players (including you) must act and speak in slow motion. The first to forget and act normal, drinks 3.

[COMPASS] THE IMITATOR: Spin. The person pointed at must choose someone in the circle for you to imitate (not them). You must imitate the person until the group guesses who it is. If they don't guess in 1 min, you drink 3.
The Robot: Speak like a robot (metallic voice and locked movements) until your next turn. If you break character, drink 1.
Hands Behind: Drink your next sip with your hands behind your back (without using your hands to grab the cup).
[DICE] The Little Dance: Roll the dice. The number is how many seconds (x5) you must do the most ridiculous dance you can (Ex: 3 = 15 seconds).
The Announcer: Speak like a radio host or TV commercial announcer for 1 full round.
The Chicken: You must cluck (instead of laughing) every time you find something funny. Valid for 2 rounds. If you laugh normally, drink 1.
The Floor is Acid: No one can put their cup on the floor. The first to put their cup on the floor (and not on the table, counter, etc), drinks 2. Valid until your next turn.
cards_weirdo_raros: 👽 ALIEN INVASION: [COMPASS] Use the compass! The person pointed at was abducted. They must speak in an 'alien language' for 2 rounds. If they speak Portuguese, drink!

🎭 RANDOM PERSONALITY: [DICE] Roll the dice! 1-2: You are a crying baby. 3-4: You are a grumpy old person. 5-6: You are a performative leftist male. Act like this until someone makes you laugh. If you laugh, drink!
🤪 MADNESS CARD: Everyone must whisper a random action in the ear of the person to their right. On the count of 3, EVERYONE does the action they heard. Whoever doesn't do it, drinks 3 times.
⏰ STATUE CHALLENGE: Stay frozen like a statue for 20 seconds. Any movement = 1 sip.
THE CONTRACT: Choose 2 players (can't be you). They must hold hands. They are stuck. They can only let go if both agree to drink 3 sips each. Valid until one of them drinks for another reason.

THE CULT. Start your cult. Create a name (ex: 'Children of the Empty Cup') and a gesture. At any moment, you can make the gesture. The last in the circle to repeat the gesture, drinks 2. Valid until the end of the game.
[DICE] POSSESSION DICE: Roll the dice. 1-3: The player to your right 'possesses' you and chooses a personality for you (ex: 'spoiled child') for 2 rounds. 4-6: You 'possess' the player to your left.
cards_weirdo: Keep your pinky inside your nose for 3 rounds.
Every time someone asks you something, you must answer and end with 'oh that's delicious, I want more'
[COMPASS] Spin. You and the person pointed at must stare at each other without blinking. The first to blink, drink or laugh, drinks 3 sips.

Drink a cup upside down. (do this outside the house lol)

Sit like a statue and, every now and then, make unexpected movements. If someone gets scared, that person drinks. Otherwise, you drink. Valid at any time during the game
The player to your left can only speak in baby talk. You must seriously translate what they say to the group. If either of you laughs, you both drink 2. Valid for 1 round.
The Sniffer: Blindfold yourself. The circle chooses 3 random objects. You must guess what they are only by smell. Drink 1 sip for each mistake.
The Shadow Twin: Choose a player. You must copy *exactly* everything they do (drink, scratch, speak) with a 1 second delay. Valid for 2 rounds. If you mess up, drink 1.
[DICE] THE SENSORY DICE: Roll the dice. 1-2: Drink 1 sip blindfolded. 3-4: Drink 1 sip while holding your nose. 5-6: Drink 1 sip with your opposite hand.
The Mummy: Ask to be wrapped in toilet paper (or similar). Stay like that for 1 round. If you don't want to, drink 4.
THE PARALLEL UNIVERSE: Choose a bizarre physics rule (ex: 'Gravity now pulls sideways'). Everyone must pretend that rule is real for 1 round. Whoever doesn't act right, drinks 2.
THE THIRD PERSON: For 3 rounds, NO ONE can use the words 'I', 'My', 'Mine'. You must speak in third person (ex: '[Your Name] will drink'). Whoever messes up, drinks 1.
[DICE] THE TACTILE DICE: Roll the dice. You must drink your next sip while touching an object with a strange texture (ex: even=wall, odd=someone's hair).
Switched Hand: If you're right-handed, do everything with your left hand (drink, grab cards). If you're left-handed, use your right. Valid for 2 rounds. If you mess up, drink 1.
cards_languages_raros: 🌍 TOWER OF BABEL: [COMPASS] Spin the compass! Each person pointed at must say a phrase in a different language (Portuguese doesn't count!). Whoever doesn't know one, drinks 2 times.

📞 GLOBAL TELEPHONE: Whisper a phrase in English in the ear of the person to your left. They translate and pass it on in another language. At the end, compare with the original. If it changed too much, everyone drinks!
[DICE] POLYGLOT DICE: Roll the dice! Tell a 30-second story mixing THAT number of different languages. Didn't manage? Drink the number on the dice.
🗣️ INTERNATIONAL KARAOKE: Sing 30 seconds of a famous song in a foreign accent chosen by the circle. If the circle laughs too much, everyone drinks. If they don't laugh, you drink.
⏰ QUICK CHALLENGE: 30 seconds for everyone to say 'I LOVE YOU' in different languages. Whoever repeats or can't do it, drinks!
🎭 SILENT ACTING: Without saying ANYTHING, act out a famous movie scene. The circle has 40s to guess. Got it right? You drink. Wrong? Everyone drinks.

The circle must choose a language for you. You must speak in that language until the end of the round. If you forget, drink.

[DICE] THE DICTIONARY: Roll the dice. You must say that number of synonyms for a word chosen by the circle (ex: 'Big'). Failed? Drink 2.

Google Translate Fail: Say an expression in Portuguese (ex: 'Kill dog by screaming'). The player to your left translates it literally to English ('Kill dog by screaming'). If the circle laughs, the translator is saved. If not, they drink.
The 'A' Game: Speak for 30 seconds about any topic, but without using words that have the letter 'A'. If you use one, drink 3.
